mapplus.desk.tool.line.description: Draw a line: drag from one end to the other
mapplus.desk.tool.box.description: Draw a box: drag from one corner to the other
mapplus.desk.tool.fill.description: Fill an area up to the ink around it
mapplus.desk.tool.border.description: Draw a dashed border: drag from one end to the other
mapplus.desk.tool.label: Sign
mapplus.desk.tool.label.description: Write a label: click the map and type. Scroll to size it, Enter to place it
mapplus.desk.tool.pin.description: Pin the banner to the map, with its name if it has one
mapplus.desk.rack.loom: Needs a loom next to the table
mapplus.desk.hint.map: Place a map, or an empty map to draw on
mapplus.desk.hint.tool: Pick up a tool to draw with: a feather or brush, string, an item frame or a bucket
mapplus.desk.hint.tool_loom: Pick up a tool to draw with: a feather or brush, string, an item frame or a bucket. To mark the map up: a sign, a banner or an iron chain
mapplus.desk.hint.loom: Place a loom next to the table to mark maps up with labels, pins and borders
mapplus.desk.hint.material: Place a dye or ink sac to draw, a glow ink sac to make ink glow, or a water bottle to erase
mapplus.desk.hint.label_ink: Place a dye or ink sac to write in that color
mapplus.desk.hint.label_edit: Click to rewrite this label, drag it to move it, or drag it off the map to remove it
mapplus.desk.hint.pin_edit: Drag this pin to move it, or off the map to remove it
mapplus.desk.hint.pin_canvas: Draw on the empty map first; pins go on a map
mapplus.desk.hint.sealed: Sealed with wax. Scrape it off with an axe to draw again.
mapplus.desk.hint.sealed_by_other: Sealed with wax by another player. Only they, the map's maker or an operator can scrape it off.
